premises.text: Converting pre-consumer food waste into insect protein and fertilizer solves waste and protein shortage together
premises.evidence_span: convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems

premises.text: Specially designed hatchery and incubator accelerate edible-insect growth on ground food waste, yielding insects and fertilizer
premises.evidence_span: place the ground food waste and insect eggs together in another specially designed incubator that accelerates the insect growth and food decomposition

premises.text: Triple revenue: tip fees for waste intake, insect protein powder sales, and fertilizer sales
premises.evidence_span: we get revenue by taking our raw material and by selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer

premises.text: System is exponentially more resource-efficient than other protein sources and nutritionally denser than regular meat
premises.evidence_span: Our production system is exponentially more efficient than any protein sources

premises.text: Launch via pet B2C/B2B (influencers, pet shops), then human niches including athletes, renal/cancer patients, and meat-allergic consumers
premises.evidence_span: we first target three initial customer segments. One is athletes who already use whey protein

value.text: Sustainable edible-insect protein powder and fertilizer from food waste
value.evidence_span: produces the next generation protein from a specific edible insect by converting food waste into fertilizer

grind the insect into protein powder, which is ready for consumption
selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer
